rationale: The Lean theorem is a nonvacuous exact Frobenius-norm lemma corresponding to the algebraic pattern in the appendix. The selected paper result is instead a prefixwise spectral-norm theorem about matrices computed by CGS-P under full-rank, floating-point, strict smallness, explicit-constant, and first-order assumptions. Because the complete statements have different domains, norms, hypotheses, conclusions, and neither implication direction holds, the result is not-faithful-different.
